create_grasp_manager: create a RearrangeGraspManager instance with a simulator, config, and managed robot
snap_to_object: snap a rigid object to the robot end effector using snap_to_obj with a given object id
snap_to_marker: snap to an articulated object marker using snap_to_marker with the marker name
desnap_object: remove active hold constraints and release the grasped object using desnap with force option
check_hold_violation: check if the grasped object violates the hold constraint using is_violating_hold_constraint
